definition: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed
examples: Children in this country start school at the age of six.

definition: To regard as probable; expect or predict
examples: We anticipate that the project will be completed by next month.

definition: An extremely accurate type of clock which is regulated by the vibrations of an atomic or molecular system
examples: Global time standards are maintained using a network of atomic clocks.

definition: A printed or written statement of the money owed for goods or services
examples: We asked the waiter for the bill at the end of our meal.

definition: A small, flat, crisp unleavened cake
examples: She enjoyed a cup of afternoon tea with a chocolate biscuit.

definition: One of the twelve months of the year as named in the calendar
examples: You must give one calendar month's notice before leaving the apartment.

definition: A thin candle with consistently spaced markings that indicate the passage of time as it burns
examples: In the Middle Ages, people sometimes used a candle clock to measure time indoors at night.

definition: A sweet food made with sugar or syrup, often combined with fruit or chocolate
examples: The children received bags of colorful candy on the holiday.

definition: A portable telephone that works by means of a cellular radio system
examples: Don't forget to charge your cell phone before leaving the house.

definition: A period of one hundred years
examples: The historic castle was built in the fourteenth century.

definition: An examination to test or ascertain accuracy, quality, or satisfactory condition; or a restaurant bill
examples: The mechanic performed a routine safety check on the car's brakes.

definition: A small sweet cake, typically round, flat, and crisp
examples: He baked a batch of warm chocolate chip cookies.

definition: A period of ten years
examples: Technology has changed dramatically over the past decade.

definition: The time or date (twice each year) at which the sun crosses the celestial equator, when day and night are of equal length
examples: Day and night are almost exactly the same length during the spring equinox.

definition: An indefinite and very long period of time
examples: These rocks were formed eons ago during the early history of the Earth.

definition: A thing that happens, especially one of importance
examples: The annual music festival is the biggest cultural event in the town.

definition: To give gifts to one another on a special occasion
examples: On New Year's Eve, our family gathers around the tree to exchange presents.

definition: An occasion when many members of an extended family meet together
examples: My grandmother's birthday is always a huge family gathering.

definition: A thin flexible strip of plastic or other material coated with light-sensitive emulsion for exposure in a camera; or a movie
examples: He still enjoys taking photographs with an old camera that uses black-and-white film.

definition: A battery-operated portable light
examples: We used a flashlight to find our way back to the tent in the dark.

definition: A set of rooms forming an individual residence, typically on one floor; or a level surface
examples: They rented a small two-bedroom flat in the center of the city.

definition: Measurement of length using the imperial unit of a foot (12 inches or 30.48 cm)
examples: In aviation, altitude is traditionally calculated using foot measure.

definition: A main road, especially one connecting major towns or cities
examples: Driving on the highway is much faster than taking the narrow country roads.

definition: A device with two connected glass bulbs containing sand that takes a specific amount of time to pass from the upper to the lower bulb
examples: The board game comes with a small plastic hourglass to time each player's turn.

definition: A year, occurring once every four years, that has 366 days including February 29 as an intercalary day
examples: Because it is a leap year, February has twenty-nine days instead of twenty-eight.

definition: A platform or compartment housed in a shaft for raising and lowering people or things to different floors; or an upward movement
examples: Since our office is on the десятый floor, we always take the lift.

definition: A row of written or printed words, a long narrow mark, or a row of people waiting their turn
examples: Please sign your name on the dotted line at the bottom of the page.

definition: A month measured between successive new moons (roughly 29.5 days)
examples: Traditional Islamic and Hebrew calendars are based on the cycle of the lunar month.

definition: A precision timepiece that is carried on a ship and employed in the determination of the ship's position by celestial navigation
examples: The invention of the marine chronometer allowed sailors to accurately calculate longitude at sea.

definition: A clock that uses a mechanical mechanism such as weights, gears, and springs to keep time
examples: You have to wind up this antique mechanical clock once a week.

definition: A period of a thousand years
examples: People all around the globe celebrated the start of the new millennium in the year 2000.

definition: One thousandth of a second
examples: In Olympic sprinting, the winner can be decided by just a few milliseconds.

definition: A mobile phone, a decorative structure suspended in the air, or a motor home (mobile home)
examples: Call me on my mobile as soon as you arrive at the station.

definition: A wide road designed for fast-moving traffic over long distances
examples: There is a speed limit of 70 miles per hour on the motorway.

definition: A raised paved or asphalted path for pedestrians at the side of a road
examples: Cyclists are not allowed to ride on the pedestrian pavement.

definition: A clock that uses a swinging weight (a pendulum) as its timekeeping element
examples: The old pendulum clock in the hallway chimes every hour.

definition: A light fuel oil that is obtained by refining petroleum and is used in internal combustion engines
examples: We need to stop at the next station to fill the car up with petrol.

definition: To make food ready for cooking or eating
examples: He likes to prepare a healthy meal for his family every evening.

definition: An instrument used to measure and display the pressure of a gas or liquid
examples: Check the pressure gauge before inflating the car tires.

definition: An official holiday established by law on which banks, schools, and most businesses are closed
examples: Next Monday is a public holiday, so we have a long three-day weekend.

definition: A watch worn on the wrist that is regulated by a tiny quartz crystal
examples: A battery-powered quartz wristwatch is very accurate and requires little maintenance.

definition: A line or sequence of people or vehicles awaiting their turn to be attended to or to proceed
examples: There was a long queue of people waiting outside the cinema.

definition: Each of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, and winter) marked by particular weather patterns
examples: Autumn is my favorite season because of the colorful leaves.

definition: A paved path for pedestrians at the side of a road
examples: After the snowstorm, residents had to shovel the snow off the sidewalk.

definition: Soft shoes with rubber soles worn for sports or casual occasions
examples: He wore a comfortable pair of white sneakers for the long walk.

definition: Particular types of food prepared for a specific holiday, celebration, or event
examples: For the festival, my mother always cooks traditional special dishes.

definition: An important or celebratory event or day, such as a wedding, birthday, or anniversary
examples: She bought an elegant dress to wear for the special occasion.

definition: A special watch with buttons that start, stop, and then zero the hands, used to time races
examples: The coach used a digital stopwatch to time the runners during practice.

definition: An instrument showing the time by the shadow of a pointer cast by the sun onto a plate marked with the hours of the day
examples: In the center of the sunny garden stood an old stone sundial.

definition: Small shaped pieces of sweet food made with sugar
examples: Eating too many sweets is bad for your teeth.

definition: A device by which a flow of liquid or gas from a pipe or container can be controlled
examples: Please turn off the tap tightly so it doesn't drip.

definition: A device that automatically regulates temperature, or that activates a device when the temperature reaches a certain point
examples: I turned up the thermostat because the house was getting cold.

definition: A surveying instrument with a rotating telescope for measuring horizontal and vertical angles
examples: The civil engineer set up a theodolite on a tripod to survey the construction site.

definition: A fixed receptacle into which a person may urinate or defecate, or a room containing this
examples: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest public toilet is?

definition: A portable battery-powered electric lamp, or a device that produces a hot flame
examples: He shone his torch into the dark cave to see what was inside.

definition: Existing in or as part of a long-established tradition
examples: Our hosts served us a delicious traditional meal from their region.

definition: A soft shoe, suitable for sports or casual wear
examples: You need to wear clean trainers when using the school gym.

definition: An ancient timekeeping device that measures time by the regulated flow of liquid into or out from a vessel
examples: Before mechanical gears were invented, ancient Greeks used a water clock to time speeches.
